speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to my clinic. I see you have a rash on your scalp and forehead; tell me, how long has this been present and has it been itchy, painful, or scaly?

speaker: Patient
text: 3-month-old boy. The parents report that the rash has been present for several weeks, noting that it sometimes appears red and scaly, especially during cold weather. The patient was born at 36 weeks' gestation and has been generally healthy since. The patient's father has a history of psoriasis.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Seborrheic Dermatitis (cradle cap) or Atopic Dermatitis. Given the age, location, and seasonal worsening, I suspect cradle cap, but the family history of psoriasis is concerning. REQUEST IMAGES: Scalp and forehead clinical photos.
